content.text: {"core": "Reciprocity gives back what it takes, matching each return to what came before so nothing piles up owed. At Source, the threshold where things first arrive, it meets what enters with an answering return in kind. In proportion, arrival and return stay linked, and nothing incoming stalls into a debt that clogs the way in.", "sheetLine": "What comes in gets an answer back; the doorway stays clear."}
